transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

Honestly, doctor, I've just been feeling this incredible, overwhelming surge of energy for the past month, like I'm on top of the world and just have to keep moving. But at the same time, I've been getting so easily irritated and angry at the smallest things. I just can't seem to sit still or slow down at all!
Have you had any experiences like hearing or seeing things that others do not, or feeling very strongly that people are trying to harm you or that you have special powers?

Yes, I've been hearing whispering voices and seeing strange figures that nobody else can see. I also feel like people are watching and trying to harm me, but I know I have special, extraordinary powers that will protect me. These experiences started happening just this past month alongside all this intense energy.
